title: OpenAI Helped Find Potentially Catastrophic Cyber Flaw
text: OpenAI’s model helped identify a potentially catastrophic cybersecurity vulnerability in a programming language that runs millions of websites and applications. Greg Brockman, president of OpenAI, and Matthew Prince, CEO of Cloudflare — which helped protect websites before the flaw was publicly exposed — join Ed Ludlow on “Bloomberg Tech” to explain how AI is empowering cyber defenders and attackers. (Source: Bloomberg)
